tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the ZeroCrew directory of AI agents, apps, and models that founders use to run a company. Use it when someone needs a tool for a job, like "customer interviews", "ai receptionist", or "bookkeeping". Matches the words against each tool's name, maker, description, and its role and job. tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one tool's public page from the ZeroCrew directory by its slug (from search_tools or list_job): what it does, its website, pricing, MCP server address if it has one, platforms, how many ZeroCrew Developers use it now and rate it a must use, Developers' published reviews (verdict, how they use it

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List every role in the ZeroCrew directory (customer support, sales, engineering, and more), the jobs inside each role, and how many live tools each has, with their zerocrew.ai pages. Use it to see what the directory covers, or to find the role and job slugs for search_tools and list_job.

tools.name: list_job
tools.description: List the tools for one job in the ZeroCrew directory, like role "support" and job "ai-receptionists", A to Z by default. ZeroCrew doesn't rank them. Set sort to "must_use" or "using_now" to order them by how many ZeroCrew Developers rate a tool a must use or use it now; the answer says which order i

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: List the AI agents and tools added to the ZeroCrew directory in the last days, newest first: the same list as the ZeroCrew weekly email. Use it for a weekly check of what is new, then pick the ones that fit the person's business. Covers the last 7 days by default, up to 30. Narrow it with role. When

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tool, whats_new · Public sink: whats_new · Destructive: search_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tool, whats_new · Public sink: whats_new · Destructive: search_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_tool" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
